app.title: HermitPDF
app.description: Privacy-first PDF toolkit that runs entirely in your browser

documentPanel.title: Workbench
documentPanel.metaDescription: Full PDF editor with drag-and-drop page management, reordering, rotation, and multi-file export. Runs entirely in your browser.
documentPanel.subtitle: Files never leave your browser
documentPanel.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

homeScreen.tagline: Privacy-first PDF toolkit. Everything runs in your browser.
homeScreen.quickActionsHint: Great for quick edits and mobile.
homeScreen.workbenchDesc: Full editor with drag-and-drop page management, reordering, rotation, and multi-file export.

mergeWizard.title: Merge Files
mergeWizard.metaDescription: Merge PDFs and images into one document. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
mergeWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
mergeWizard.overlayDescription: Combining your files — this may take a moment for large files.
mergeWizard.oversizedFiles: Files too large to load (max 1 GB): {files}
mergeWizard.imageSettingsHint: Applied to image files only ({count, plural, =1 {1 image} other {# images}} in this merge).
mergeWizard.recompressImagesDesc: Re-encode each image as JPEG, optionally capped to a paper size.
mergeWizard.resizeHint: Caps image dimensions so they fit the chosen paper at the chosen DPI. Use 72 for on-screen viewing, 150 for general print, 300 for photo-quality print.

collateWizard.title: Collate PDFs
collateWizard.metaDescription: Interleave the pages of two PDFs into one document. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
collateWizard.dropSubtitle: Their pages will be interleaved into one document
collateWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
collateWizard.dragToReorder: Drag to set which document leads
collateWizard.collateHint: Pages are interleaved: page 1 of the first document, then page 1 of the second, and so on. Leftover pages from the longer document are appended at the end.
collateWizard.reverseSecondDesc: Interleave the second document back-to-front — useful when its pages were scanned in reverse order (e.g. duplex back sides).
collateWizard.overlayDescription: Interleaving your pages — this may take a moment for large files.
collateWizard.oversizedFiles: Files too large to load (max 1 GB): {files}

splitWizard.title: Split PDF
splitWizard.metaDescription: Split a PDF into multiple files by page ranges. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
splitWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
splitWizard.splitInfo: Each range will be saved as a separate PDF.
splitWizard.overlayDescription: Building each range — this may take a moment for large PDFs.
splitWizard.sectionsCount: {count, plural, =1 {1 section selected} other {# sections selected}}
splitWizard.chunkPagesInfo: {count, plural, =1 {The whole document fits in a single file.} other {The document will be split into # files.}}
splitWizard.chunkSizeInfo: Consecutive pages are packed into files that stay under the size limit. The number of files depends on the content.
splitWizard.chunkPageTooLarge: Page {page} alone is {size}, which exceeds the {limit} limit. Increase the size limit and try again.
splitWizard.chunkInvalid: Enter a value greater than zero.
splitWizard.tocNoneDescription: This PDF has no bookmarks to split by. Switch to Page ranges to split manually.
splitWizard.tocSplitInfo: Each selected entry will be saved as a separate PDF using its page range.
splitWizard.onlyOneFile: Only one file can be split at a time. Using the first PDF.

common.storageUnsupported: Your browser is blocking the local file storage HermitPDF needs, so files can't be loaded. This happens on plain-HTTP addresses other than localhost (e.g. when opened via a LAN IP) and in some private-browsing modes. Open the app over HTTPS or on localhost.
common.loadingFilesDescription: Reading and preparing your files — this may take a moment for large files.

unlockWizard.metaDescription: Remove password protection from a PDF file. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.

protectWizard.title: Protect PDF
protectWizard.metaDescription: Add a password to a PDF file. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
protectWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
protectWizard.encryptionNote: The file will be encrypted with AES-256. The same password is required to open and to edit the document.
protectWizard.statusEnterPassword: Enter a password to protect the file

compressWizard.title: Compress PDF
compressWizard.metaDescription: Shrink PDF file size by recompressing images and stripping unused data. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
compressWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
compressWizard.recompressImagesDesc: Re-encode embedded images as JPEG, optionally capped to a paper size. The biggest source of savings for image-heavy PDFs.
compressWizard.subsetFontsDesc: Strip unused glyphs from embedded fonts.
compressWizard.deduplicateObjectsDesc: Merge identical resources into a single copy.
compressWizard.sanitizeStreamsDesc: Remove redundant operators from page content.
compressWizard.previewHint: Click Update preview to see how a page will look after compression.
compressWizard.resultPlaceholder: Click Calculate savings to compress this PDF and see the size difference.
compressWizard.outdated: Settings have changed since this was calculated — recalculate to update.
compressWizard.noSavingsHint: This PDF is already well-compressed. Try lowering image quality for more savings.
compressWizard.overlayDescription: Compression can take a while for large or image-heavy PDFs. Hang tight.
compressWizard.onlyOneFile: Only one file can be processed at a time. Using the first PDF.
compressWizard.oversizedFiles: Files too large to load (max 1 GB): {files}
compressWizard.resizeHint: Caps image dimensions so they fit the chosen paper at the chosen DPI. Use 72 for on-screen viewing, 150 for general print, 300 for photo-quality print.

extractImagesWizard.title: Extract Images
extractImagesWizard.metaDescription: Extract all embedded images from a PDF file. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
extractImagesWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
extractImagesWizard.noImagesFound: No embedded images found in this document.
extractImagesWizard.onlyOneFile: Only one file can be processed at a time. Using the first PDF.
extractImagesWizard.imagesFound: {count, plural, =1 {1 image found} other {# images found}}
extractImagesWizard.formatNote: JPEG and JPEG 2000 images are extracted as-is, with color profiles preserved. Other image formats are converted to PNG.

attachWizard.title: Prepend & Append
attachWizard.metaDescription: Add cover pages or attachments to many PDFs at once — prepend or append the same PDFs to every file. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
attachWizard.dropSubtitle: or click to browse — start with the documents that should receive pages
attachWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
attachWizard.documentsHint: Each of these files gets its own download with the added pages.
attachWizard.prependHint: These pages are placed before the first page of every document.
attachWizard.appendHint: These pages are placed after the last page of every document.
attachWizard.statusSummary: {documents, plural, =1 {1 document} other {# documents}} · {attachments, plural, =1 {1 file added to each} other {# files added to each}}
attachWizard.needDocuments: Add at least one document to receive the files
attachWizard.needAttachments: Add at least one file to the beginning or the end
attachWizard.overlayDescription: Building each document — this may take a moment for large PDFs.

contrastWizard.title: Boost Contrast
contrastWizard.metaDescription: Darken faded PDF scans by adjusting contrast, brightness, and threshold. Free, private, and runs entirely in your browser.
contrastWizard.privacyNote: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.
contrastWizard.thresholdDesc: Force every pixel to pure black or white. Useful for very faded scans.
contrastWizard.exportQualityHint: Higher DPI means sharper output but a larger file. The exported PDF is made of images — original selectable text becomes part of the image.
contrastWizard.noChanges: Adjust a slider to see changes
contrastWizard.overlayDescription: Rasterizing each page with your adjustments — this may take a moment for large PDFs.
